impact_basis: Eliminates incorrect medical test orders and case rework caused by underwriters using outdated photocopied medical grid versions (TK-02, TK-03, TK-09).
name: Medical Grid Orchestration Agent
what_the_agent_does: Evaluates proposer age, sum assured, smoker status, and BMI against the live medical grid rules, queries `/underwriting/medical-grid` to retrieve the correct test requirements, and calls `/submissions/{id}/medical/tests` to order standard tests automatically, eliminating the use of outdated paper grids.
reads: Guidewire PolicyCenter proposer demographics; sumInsured; smoker_status; height; weight; BMI
writes: Guidewire PolicyCenter ordered tests grid via /submissions/{id}/medical/tests
how_errors_are_caught: Underwriters review the automated test orders in the PolicyCenter screen before they are dispatched to third-party lab administrators.
why_recommended_or_not: Highly buildable against existing APIs and directly addresses a known source of heavy case rework.

impact_basis: Bypasses the PolicyCenter auto-calc system defect where incorrect BMI calculations are silently produced for non-metric inputs (TK-06, TK-07).
name: Clinical MER Parser & BMI Validator
what_the_agent_does: Reads raw clinical medical examiner reports, extracts height and weight metrics, automatically standardizes units to centimeters and kilograms, calculates corrected BMI, and drafts vitals records via API to bypass PolicyCenter auto-calc system defects.
reads: Medical Examiner Report (PDF); Raw height and weight metrics
how_errors_are_caught: PolicyCenter highlights calculated BMI values that deviate by more than 1% from the raw examiner reports for manual underwriter verification.
why_recommended_or_not: Addresses a persistent system defect that forces manual double-checking of every single report by underwriters.

impact_basis: Reduces reinsurance referral latency by compiling and preparing the provisional alert package in parallel with outstanding medical wait times (TK-04).
name: Early Provisional Referral Drafter
what_the_agent_does: Scans intake details for reinsurer triggers (sum assured > Rs 2.5 Cr or hazardous occupation) and automatically drafts a standardized one-page provisional summary to alert Atlas Re early.
reads: Proposer profile; Applied Sum Assured; Occupation details
writes: Provisional summary alert draft in PolicyCenter
how_errors_are_caught: Underwriters review and authorize the provisional summary draft before it is dispatched to Atlas Re.
why_recommended_or_not: Speeds up high-value case cycle times by aligning system behaviors with the parallel workflows underwriters already perform manually.

impact_basis: Ensures full data capture of override reasons, preventing audit failures and compliance breaches identified months after issue (TK-08).
name: Risk Assessment Rating Audit Agent
what_the_agent_does: Monitors the Pricing and Risk screen for manual Extra Mortality overrides and validates that a specific, medically-justified override reason is populated before submitting.
reads: Rating engine suggested EM; Underwriter override EM value; Override reason field
how_errors_are_caught: A validation warning prevents submission to the API if the override reason is blank or generic (e.g., 'override').
why_recommended_or_not: Enforces a critical compliance check directly on the PolicyCenter API contract to eliminate downstream audit failures.

impact_basis: Reduces case touch time by gathering, sorting, and pre-formatting treaty limits and underwriter assessments into the standard referral payload.
name: Facultative Referral Package Drafter
what_the_agent_does: Checks configured treaty and acceptance limits via `/reinsurance/treaty-limits`, assembles the required medical summaries and HLV financial checks, and drafts the facultative referral request for Chief Underwriting Officer or reinsurer dispatch.
reads: /reinsurance/treaty-limits response; Medical profile summaries; Financial HLV assessment details
how_errors_are_caught: The dispatching underwriter performs a final verification of the generated referral package parameters prior to submitting the API call.
why_recommended_or_not: Depends on complex structured data compilation from multiple screens; should be scheduled after the medical grid and parsing blocks are established.
